articles.title: NEET-UG re-examination concludes, candidates describe paper moderate to tough
articles.summary: The NEET-UG re-examination concluded on Sunday, with candidates largely describing the overall paper as moderate in difficulty. In New Delhi, examinees noted the Physics section was comparatively challenging, while other parts were deemed manageable. This re-exam follows recent controversies surrounding the initial test, impacting thousands of aspiring medical students nationwide and highlighting ongoing educational challenges.
